conversion.geofence: empty: site perimeter/exclusions are NOT exported as a fence (FENCE_* not verified)

items.source: takeoff to the first waypoint altitude (as the SITL executor does)

items.note: REQUESTED maximum speed; runs when the preceding NAV item completes; not validated

items.source: return_to_home -> land at the planned home coordinate

conversion.label_scope: EXACT: the named element of the file equals the corresponding element of the mission (or of the H2 record where stated). It does not claim dynamic equivalence with H2, QGroundControl or vehicle compatibility, or any flight guarantee. CONDITIONED: the element is present but its effect depends on something outside the file (autopilot parameters, arming position). NOT_IN_PLAN: not expressed.

precision.transport: MISSION_ITEM_INT carries degE7 (~1.1 cm); see verifier

semantics.detail: NAV_TAKEOFF to the first waypoint altitude, relative to the EFFECTIVE home (set at arming); equals the executor's launch-relative target only if armed at the planned takeoff position
item lat/lon/alt equal the mission waypoint values (8 decimals; degE7 transport quantization reported); says nothing about the flown path

ArduCopter accepts within WP_RADIUS_M and does not stop at a waypoint followed by another navigation item (hold 0); the H2 executor sent targets one by one and accepted at 1.0 m horizontal / 0.75 m vertical
param1 = 0, matching the mission model, which has no hold field; the vehicle's dwell is not implied (see waypoint acceptance)
not specified by the mission (param4 NaN): WP_YAW_BEHAVIOR decides; the executor commanded no yaw either
requested [10.0] km/h as DO_CHANGE_SPEED (maximum horizontal speed, bounded by the autopilot); the GUIDED executor did not apply speed_kmh

NAV_LAND coordinate = the planned home coordinate; the executor returned to the OBSERVED launch position, equal only if the vehicle launches at the planned coordinate. The motion differs: H2 sent a GUIDED target and waited within 1.0 m before LAND; ArduCopter flies the NAV_LAND leg at the current altitude, then descends (not RTL, not the effective home)
an explicit NAV_LAND item is present, as H2 always commanded LAND; it does not depend on RTL_ALT_FINAL_M. Descent and touchdown behaviour depend on LAND_* parameters
low battery / wind / link loss actions are autopilot parameters (FS_*), not mission items; the mission's failsafe block is not expressed
battery, wind and constraints are validation inputs only

speed_fields.meaning: QGC planning fields; not converted into a commanded speed

planned_home.amsl_source: site vertical_reference.origin_ground_amsl_m (DECLARED_FLAT); not the effective home

verification.compatibility: NOT_ESTABLISHED: not imported in QGroundControl, not uploaded, not read back from a vehicle

losses: MAV_CMD_NAV_TAKEOFF was not converted into a horizontal waypoint. Vertical takeoff dynamics are not modelled yet.
MAV_CMD_NAV_LAND was converted to a navigation endpoint. Landing dynamics are not modelled yet.
NAV_LAND represented as an extra navigation waypoint; landing and return meaning lost

coordination.note: dependencies are conditions on OBSERVED outcomes held by the coordinator; never a time wait. Individual .plan files do not coordinate vehicles.

ground_tasks.execution: outside this package: R1 coordinator gates unchanged
ground_tasks.export: FORMAT_PENDING: no rover exporter; a .plan is not assumed

checks.detail: the aerial perimeter is never used for the rover

spatial_validation.scope: straight planned line only; no path planner; rover frame transform not accredited

limitations: checks cover planned straight lines, not flown trajectories, unknown obstacles or collisions
relative altitudes refer to the EFFECTIVE home set at arming, not to plannedHomePosition
requested speeds are DO_CHANGE_SPEED requests, not validated speeds
the .plan returns to a planned COORDINATE and lands (NAV_LAND); it does not use RTL
individual .plan files do not coordinate vehicles; order and dependencies live in the coordinator
our importer reads the file back with losses (TAKEOFF dropped, LAND reduced to a waypoint)
pending_conditions: conditioned or not in the .plan: failsafe actions, planning inputs, return coordinate, speed, takeoff, waypoint acceptance, yaw
autopilot parameters not read: WP_RADIUS_M (waypoint acceptance), WP_YAW_BEHAVIOR (yaw), WP_SPD (default speed), FS_* (failsafe actions), LAND_SPD_MS / descent (landing rate)
